svg.title: Proposed specification-driven verification demonstration
svg.desc: A developer brings create-new-product.md and invokes an illustrative proposed CLI command. The agent drafts new-product.feature and requests developer approval. Only after approval does the agent discover product-service, PostgreSQL, and Redis, prepare infrastructure and the catalog, generate new-product.spec.ts, and complete its fixtures, client actions, and assertions. Playwright runs the tests; the Sandbox starts the application and dependencies, live logs appear, and an illustrative HTML report shows creation and cache retrieval results with linked evidence. The 48-second animation highlights the stages in order, types the Feature, pauses for approval, reveals the topology and configuration, spawns the Sandbox, appends log lines, and reveals the report. This is a proposed workflow demonstration, not documentation of an available end-to-end command. The starting command is illustrative; the feature generation and Playwright test commands use the existing documented command shapes. With reduced motion, the complete flow remains visible without animation.
svg.text: The test invocation starts the Sandbox
